title: peak/<node>/event
description: Published by a sense on the Mac: something worth a thought (heard, see, sensed) or quiet context (doing). The mind strips `at` before the brain sees the event, so the prompt is unchanged.

heard.description: speech aimed at Rho, after the wake-word gate (hearing.js)

see.description: what the camera noticed, scene mode (vision.js)

sensed.description: what the body's own sensors felt (presence.js)

doing.description: what the hands at the desk are doing; context kept for the next heard event, never answered (vision.js desk mode)

at.description: Unix time in ms when the sense published it. Optional: an event without it (a hand mosquitto_pub) counts as fresh.
